parentMetric.implementation: R196 explicit shared nonuniform cubic basis; frozen R190 formulas
parentMetric.angularPrimitive: complete quarter-cell Gauss8 with actual first moment; no Fourier projection
parentMetric.angularMetric: exactly a^2 in mathematical complete definition
parentMetric.radialMetric: R181 B32 plus complete C2 radius B-spline design; changing rho changes g
parentMetric.boundary: complete central ellipse cylinder and zero-tail round flat cut two jets
parentMetric.radiusGrid: R196 explicit simple nonuniform cubic B-splines, at most four active radial blocks, C2 zero endpoint extension
parentMetric.residual: rE=|Xs|^2-1 and rF=Xs dot T, weighted squared rE^2+2*rF^2
parentMetric.radialQuadrature: Gauss2 on union of original phase/Hermite breaks and spline knots
parentMetric.derivative: complete state and primitive first-moment derivatives, fixed physical s and u

providerDefinition.meanPhase: Complete half-period C+iS integral, algebraic rotation; derivatives include beta_p,beta_sp,beta_ssp
providerDefinition.primitive: R201 full half-period zero-full-mean kernels, Gauss8 split at every R205 frozen-base angular clip; no quarter reflection

developedTailReference.referenceRadialDependency: the frozen B32 base a(s), a_s(s), a_ss(s); excludes radius-design coefficients
developedTailReference.blend: S5((s-c)/(S-c)), with exact constant extensions and zero endpoint first two jets
developedTailReference.angleAddition: chi*(theta_tail(a_base(s),u)-u, phi_tail(a_base(s),u)); relative theta uses positive-dot atan2, so full periodic angles are explicit
developedTailReference.centerHeightSubtraction: chi*mean_u Z_A(a_base(s)*sin(u)); complete s0-s2 jets included
developedTailReference.cuffPlaneHeight: base.height + saved cutHeight coefficient; outer cut mean is this minus mean Z_A
developedTailReference.primitive: complete quarter-cell Gauss8 split additionally at a_base(s)*sin(u)=17/50 or 4/5; same exact integrals, boundaries independent of all finite parameters
developedTailReference.externalAmplitudeDerivative: angular entries 8..15 and heightCorrection.amplitude are exact-form first amplitude derivatives; A is frozen in finite state
developedTailReference.tailPositionIntegral: Gauss64 in normalized y with exact saturated-ray extension

providerDefinition.amplitudeMode: Actual appended unknown; referenceTemplate records formula at A=0, evaluation creates the reference at saved A
providerDefinition.stateAmplitudeDerivative: Complete theta/psi, beta/beta_s/beta_ss and mean-height columns; clip locations fixed in all parameters
providerDefinition.cutHeightMeaning: Inner flat-cuff Zc=original base.height+cut coefficient; outer mean subtracts complete R205 section mean
providerDefinition.exactLegacyInjection: Copy R205 D2 coefficients and append zeros; exact same developed reference, odd phase S=0, C>0. Copying an old flat state instead is an explicitly new baseline.
providerDefinition.cutAndCentral: R205 complete raw angular and mean-height twojets, zero-twojet state corrections; R201 theorem applies at the developed outer cut
providerDefinition.parameterJets: All theta sin/cos/constant, psi sin/cos, height, cut height, rho and actual tail amplitude; fixed physical s,u
providerDefinition.radialLocality: Local radial blocks preserved; cut height and tail amplitude are the two explicitly declared global columns
